title: Binance Will Add Kaia (KAIA) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, and Margin
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Kaia (KAIA)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert , and   Binance Margin  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn KAIA Simple Earn Flexible Products  will be listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2024-10-31 08:00 (UTC)  and will be  available for subscription . Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy KAIA  with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay,  or buy and sell KAIA with their  wallet balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of KAIA being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading KAIA against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of KAIA being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Binance Margin will add KAIA as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  KAIA/USDT  pair on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2024-10-31 10:00 (UTC). Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2024-10-31
